artDirection: Underworld细像素家族 v2；16区完整47邻接、区域构件、平台近景与定向局部光

qualityContract.sharedLayoutPurpose: 同一灰盒用于比较16区材质和光影，不代表16个正式关卡
qualityContract.terrainCoverage: 16 regions × 47 normalized blob adjacency states in separate native32 atlases
qualityContract.depthLayers: far plate + independent middle layers + world terrain/props/hero + attached foreground + independent near foreground + particles
qualityContract.hazards: 独立危险素材与示例摆放；不包含伤害玩法
qualityContract.terrain47: 47 normalized 8-neighbor states per region; native tile 32x32; isolated/concave/thin forms verified separately
qualityContract.foregroundV2: independent complete low silhouettes, close to platform height; rooted attached props remain world speed 1; floating near clumps use world-space platform band and local hero reveal

releaseNotes.backgrounds: New Windchime Plains and Thorn Forest plates; previous plates retained as explicit variants.
releaseNotes.terrain: All 16 regions use a separate 47-mask atlas manifest; legacy nine-slice remains for compatibility.
releaseNotes.depth: 32 redrawn mid/near independent sprites with natural ends; near clumps use a local mask, not full-screen framing.
releaseNotes.newProps: 64 new regional props are delivered; two per region are placed in this density-controlled sample.
releaseNotes.sampleScope: Art assembly and adjacency/depth behavior sample; hazard art and visual props do not add damage or other gameplay logic.
